Good Questions

Frequently Asked

Do you move furniture?

We move light furniture and clean around the rest.

How long until carpets are dry?

Usually 4–6 hours with our fast-dry extraction process.

Can you remove old set-in stains?

Often, yes — we treat each stain by type for the best result.

Is there a minimum charge?

We'll give you a clear flat price before any work begins.

How often should I clean carpets?

Every 6–12 months keeps them fresh and extends their life.
